questions.question: What does a constructor primarily do?
questions.explanation: A constructor establishes the object's initial state and has no return type.

questions.question: Inside acc.deposit(50), what does this refer to?
options: The Account object referenced by acc
questions.explanation: The receiver object becomes this during an instance-method call.

questions.question: What belongs to a Java method signature?
questions.explanation: Overloading is distinguished by the name and parameter-type sequence.

questions.question: Why are Account fields normally private?
options: To make changes go through class-controlled methods
questions.explanation: Encapsulation protects invariants and hides implementation details.
